purpose: Per-family parameters of the standard water chain (spatial x4 -> 30 fps -> contours). A/B are validated on lake AR1600, sewage AR2100, pool AR0408/AR0703 and swamp AR0500/AR0500N; lava B on AR5200; oil A/B on AR0503; brown_flow A/B/C on AR5000; lake_teal B/C on AR6300. C = matte + spline fit 1 validated on every family test map (2026-09-25), per-map exceptions in contour_map_overrides.

defaults.seedvr: 7B INT8 convrot, color_correction none, seed 959948902156062, periodic 3x3 context, centre crop
defaults.seam_mode: compatible (collar applied only when a seam is measured as amplified vs stock)
defaults.timeline_spatial: native lookup, speed and duration kept (no 6->36)
defaults.rain: resref + R when present in the vanilla KEY; WED names the dry alias only

contour.current_policy: matte + spline fit 1.0 (x4 px) on every foreground/shore silhouette over water; per-map exceptions below
contour.history: gaussian matte provisional 2026-09-23..25 (ar0500n-contour-user-qa-20260924-v1.json); spline fit 1 validated AR1600 then on every family test map

AR0408.why: user 2026-09-25: keep the earlier gaussian matte on this map (map-specific, not the pool family)

AR0703.why: user 2026-09-25: keep the earlier gaussian matte on this map (map-specific, not the pool family)

families.why: SeedVR amplifies the diagonal weave into a grid

temporal.why_strength: bilinear WTPOOL is near-flat (std 5.5/255): its timeline alone reads frozen (AR1000 v3, AR0408 30fps v1); route2 q0.70 material 1 on the dry group (AR1000 v5, AR0408 v2); rain stays q0
temporal.why_cycle: 6 keys x speed 6 / 15 Hz validated on AR0408; AR1004, AR1601, AR2012 carry speed 0

contour.status: spline-fit1-default; AR0408/AR0703 keep the earlier gaussian matte (map exceptions, 2026-09-25)

temporal.why: AR0500 and AR0500N validate the standard 72-phase 2.4 s producer with material 5 q0.70 on dry identities; rain identities use the historical AR1607/AR1800 q0.70 contract but were not observed in these QA sessions

contour.reserve: current matte accepted as-is; CONTOUR-NET adaptation declined

temporal.why_method: the edge collar left a ~10 px smeared band on every 64 px tile border; seedvr-torus 1x1 joins without blur (wrap 1.22/0.94)
temporal.why_filters: WTOIL keys are shimmer (key-to-key corr 0.65-0.76): 65 % of SeedVR phase-to-phase change was boiling detail plus the 4-frame latent cadence (0.73); harmonics <= 9 (1.5 x keys) + detail equalisation: step median 1.02 -> 0.42, cadence flat, sharpness max/min 1.34 -> 1.15 (AR0503 v1 -> v2)

temporal.why_cycle: 8 keys x 16 = 128 phases; AR6300 WED speeds 0/0/0/0 (no reference), AR3000 8/0/0/0: same 4.27 s as brown_flow, accepted in game
temporal.why_torus: all 43 AR6300 adjacencies on the torus; native borders neutral (1.02/1.02): heal off
temporal.why_no_deridge: deridge removed real content on this contrasted texture (mean change 0.47) and SeedVR turned it into a visible grid (AR6300 v2 rejected before install)
temporal.why_periodic_sigma: sigma 8 left the wrap at 1.85/1.49; sigma 2 -> 1.16/1.07

contour.spline_trial: first AR6300 trial (fit 1 alone, then fit 4 + AA) judged inconclusive; spline fit 1 then validated on every family (2026-09-25)

temporal.why_cycle: 8 keys x 16 = 128 phases, vanilla nominal 8x8/15 s (speed 8/0/0/0), accepted in game
temporal.why_torus: native 2x2 borders already softer than the interior (0.69/0.74): heal off; 0.4 % non-torus adjacencies (AR5000 cells 41-45 rows 33/34) keep their native seam
temporal.why_periodic_sigma: smooth texture: sigma 8 left the wrap at 1.85; sigma 2 -> 1.21/0.95
temporal.why_deridge: native +1 line on the tile border rows, turned by SeedVR into a 4 px band; removed at x1 (1.11 -> 0.14)

families.why: spatial stage only prepares the x1 torus contexts and topology; its bilinear WED is superseded by the 30 fps seedvr-torus build (SeedVR on 12 raw keys sharpened the native 64 px tile borders into a grid)

temporal.why_keyframes: the 12 native frames loop evenly (step 2.8, 11->0 3.1); the vanilla AR520x lookup [0..9,11] skips frame 10 (step 4.0 = 1.45x median)
temporal.why_cycle: 12 keys x 18 = 216 phases fit one 4096 page (225 max); vanilla 11x11/15 = 8.07 s nominal
temporal.why_method: WED adjacencies are exactly the 2x2 torus: seams healed at x1 (band 4, sigma 3, gain 0.8), SeedVR on motif + 32 px wrapped margin, periodic+smooth with border jump low-passed (sigma 8 x4), atlas margins from the torus neighbour; q0 timing-only, no procedural lava

blocked.local_are_bam_surfaces: ARE/BAM water surfaces (AR2300 falls, AR2804/5, AR3021 basins) follow the animation pipeline, not this chain
blocked.unknown_overlay: any liquid slot whose resource is not listed above: stop and ask
